title: The Bayesian Additive Regression Trees Formula for Safe Machine Learning-Based Intraocular Lens Predictions.
summary: Across 5,331 eyes from 3,276 patients, median absolute intraocular-lens prediction error was 0.204 diopters; out-of-sample comparisons covered centers and manufacturers. Although out-of-sample and cross-center, this retrospective prediction study does not establish prospective benefit from formula-guided surgery.
